quote: When the signal is circular green alone: Vehicular traffic facing the signal may proceed straight through or turn right or left unless another device at the place prohibits either or both such turns. Such vehicular traffic, including vehicles turning right or left, must yield the right-of-way to other vehicles and to pedestrians lawfully within the intersection or an adjacent crosswalk at the time the signal is exhibited.

activation.condition: vehicular traffic facing a circular green signal alone

exceptions.effect: turn permission does not apply for that prohibited turn
exceptions.source_clause: unless another device at the place prohibits either or both such turns
exceptions.trigger: another device at the place prohibits a turn

judgment_calls_needed.note: Native actor occupancy and source time are observable; lawful status requires original context and judgment.

obligation.description: turning traffic must yield the right-of-way to other vehicles and pedestrians lawfully within the intersection or adjacent crosswalk
